title: Mentors

description.ADMIN: Mentor sessions happen at least every two weeks. Track planned meetings, sessions awaiting notes and mentor workload.
description.MENTOR: Confirm meetings, then record your advice and next steps afterwards. An agreed next step becomes a task in one click.
description.TEAM: Share your agenda and progress before the meeting, request sessions, and follow mentor advice and next steps here.

visibility: Visible only to the project team, its mentor(s) and the coordinator

projectSection.title: Mentor sessions
projectSection.description: First the team shares its agenda, then the mentor records advice and next steps; an agreed step can be turned into a task.

stats.needsNotesHint: Time has passed, no mentor notes yet
stats.noRecentSessionHint: No session held in the last {days} days

needsNotes.title: Sessions awaiting notes

needsNotes.emptyHint: Mentor notes are recorded for all past meetings.

completed.title: Recently held sessions
completed.subtitle: Advice and next steps; you can turn a step into a task.

pool.title: Mentor pool
pool.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# active mentor} other {# active mentors}} · assignments, sessions held and mentoring hours

myMentors.subtitle: Mentors assigned to your project
myMentors.emptyHint: You can request sessions once the coordinator assigns a mentor.
myMentors.noProject: You are not on a project team yet

explainer.title: How mentor notes work
explainer.subtitle: Every session follows a four-step flow

before.title: Before the meeting
before.body: The team shares its agenda, weekly progress and questions.

after.title: After the meeting
after.body: The mentor records advice and the agreed next steps.

followup.title: Follow-up
followup.body: A next step becomes a task with an owner, due date and acceptance criterion in one click.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.body: Notes are visible only to the project team, its mentor and the coordinator.

session.noAgenda: The team hasn't shared an agenda yet.
session.needsNotesHint: The meeting is over — advice and next steps are pending.

plan.descriptionPlan: The team and mentor will be notified. The team can share an agenda before the meeting.
plan.descriptionRequest: Your mentor will confirm the request or suggest another time. Describe your progress and questions in the agenda.
plan.mentorHint: Select the project first — only assigned mentors are listed.
plan.agendaHint: Before the meeting: what was done, where are you stuck, what questions do you have?
plan.agendaPlaceholder: E.g. first field-test results, LoRa range, next sprint plan
plan.onlineHint: When off, the meeting is held in person.

complete.title: Record mentor notes
complete.notesHint: The team will see this note. Keep it concrete and actionable.
complete.stepsHint: Write each agreed step separately — it can be turned into a task later.

reschedule.title: Reschedule session
reschedule.description: “{topic}” — the team will be notified of the new time.

agendaDialog.title: Meeting agenda
agendaDialog.description: Share progress and questions before the meeting so your mentor can prepare.

cancel.title: Cancel this session?
cancel.description: “{topic}” ({when}) will be cancelled. The action is recorded in the activity log.

toast.completed: Notes saved, the team has been notified
toast.converted: Next step turned into a task

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.agendaRequired: An agenda is required (at least 3 characters).
errors.mentorNotAssigned: This mentor is not assigned to the project.
errors.datePast: A past date cannot be selected.
errors.wrongStatus: The session's current status does not allow this action.
errors.notesLength: Notes must be at least 10 characters.
errors.tooManySteps: At most 10 steps can be added.
errors.stepLength: Each step can be at most 160 characters.
